description:
Unmatched Performance:Equipped with a 48V 1000W brushless rear hub motor and a 6061 aluminum alloy frame, our electric bike delivers exceptional power and durability. With a maximum speed of around 40km/h, you'll enjoy thrilling rides that effortlessly conquer any terrain.

Smooth and Efficient Gear System:The Shimano 7-speed gear system ensures seamless transitions between gears, allowing you to optimize your riding experience. Whether you're tackling uphill climbs or cruising on flat roads, our electric bike offers versatility and efficiency.

Long-Lasting Battery Life:Powered by a 48V 13Ah lithium battery, our electric bike offers impressive range options. In fully electric mode, you can expect a range of around 40-45km, while in pedal assist mode, the range extends to approximately 60-70km. Say goodbye to range anxiety and enjoy longer rides with confidence.

Enhanced Safety Features:Ride with peace of mind, knowing that our electric bike prioritizes your safety. The mechanical disc brake system, equipped with a power cut-off feature, ensures responsive and reliable braking. The LED headlight, powered by the bike's battery, illuminates your path for added visibility during nighttime rides.

Intuitive Display and Throttle:Stay informed with the smart LCD display, providing real-time information such as speed, battery status, and pedal assist level. The twist throttle on the right side of the handlebar offers effortless acceleration, giving you full control over your riding experience.

Experience the freedom and exhilaration of our high-performance electric bike. Unleash your adventurous spirit and explore new horizons with confidence and style.

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: 1-year warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns
